name: Secutor
description: Secutor is a local-first secure packet utility. It keeps private keys inside encrypted on-device real or decoy vaults, creates transport-neutral encrypted packet files/text with X25519 + ML-KEM-768 hybrid encryption and Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65 signatures, supports AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 payloads, sequence/replay protection, encrypted attachment chunks with responsive background handling, self-destruct policies with a one-minute read window, local Shamir recovery, multiple identities, optional emergency key destruction, restricted-message screenshot blocking, public invites, detailed in-app Help, 13 supported app languages, and offline transport handoff without accounts or Internet permission.
releaseNotes: v0.2.8 help, localization, and attachment responsiveness update: adds a detailed Help section reachable before unlock and from the unlocked top bar, completes the supported-language resource sweep so all 13 supported languages carry the full string set, and moves attachment display-name/size lookup, file reads, packet encryption, packet-file import, packet save, and attachment save work off the Compose UI thread with progress states, duplicate-action guards, Android-reported size preflight checks, and localized errors. Keeps package com.lenomila.cipherpacket, no Internet permission, the Antarctica signing certificate, Android signing lineage, the v0.2.5 picker compatibility fix, v0.2.6 emergency destruction, and v0.2.7 restricted-message/transport fixes.
